verified.entry_point: HTTP GET /device/device=<id>/tab=<tab>/<vars> through the real Laravel DeviceController/LegacyController routes (device health, processes, port, routing, slas, inventory, wireless, overview) and /routing/protocol=<proto>; the alerts table through the real html/ajax_table.php endpoint. All rendered on the project's own in-memory SQLite connection inside its Laravel test framework.
routes: device health storage / sensors / mempool / processor / diskio
device processes (table cell and the injected command tooltip)
device routing proto=bgp / vrf / isis / mpls
device slas list (id=0, jitter-type row) and detail (id=<sla>)
device overview (storage, mempool, generic sensor, recent syslog)
alerts table (html/ajax_table.php): mempool, service, bgp, port/isis, app, generic, fallback, injected processor
verified.services: none at test time; SQLite :memory: (the project's own testing_memory connection), no network, no external daemon
verified.project_tests: The project has no tests for the affected legacy templates (upstream tests/ does not reference them); the functional suite covers the coupled renderer behaviour (links, line breaks, tooltips, single-encoded labels).
